text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could you give my shoulders a 
good, firm massage?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
While you're at it, I'd love it if you 
poured all your passionate feelings into 
it too, Trainer-san~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Pouring my strong feelings toward victory 
into it, I patted Wonder Acute on the 
shoulder."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Here it is, here it cooomes~~!! Trainer, I 
can feel your feelings loud and clear~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
All right! You'd better look forward to 
today's race!
